howToMakeOne.model: The catalog builds a base by pinning one source version, fixing one set of inputs, and retaining the exact objects that come out. A new variant starts from a retained base and changes only the fields it owns, so the base stays comparable and the change stays reviewable.
steps: Materialize this base and confirm the object set hashes to sha256:f2cdbe08ae9ee7c8953e396957be9bc6c3860742aec82e52fa9c4c4369b87e76. The exact objects are recorded at examples/aicr/ocp-training/argocd-rendered.
Put those objects in a local directory called rendered, then preview the retention before writing anything.
Retain the base in ConfigHub, carrying the object-set hash as an annotation so the accepted identity travels with it.
Create the new variant from that base and change only the fields the variant owns.
Preview the promotion and read the mutations before any write command runs.

requirements.detail: Apply the 13 component Applications in the 9 sync-waves they carry, from wave 0 to wave 21. The order is recorded as a route beside the bundle and no runtime has executed it.
Argo CD renders 2 upstream charts and 12 AICR bundle paths at sync time. Their CRDs, hooks, certificates and operators are handled there, and this entry has not rendered or assessed them.
Argo CD and its Application API must exist on the destination, with the argocd namespace, because every object in this base is an Argo CD Application in that namespace.

12 of the 14 Applications take their source from oci://europe-west1-docker.pkg.dev/nth-fort-499605-q5/helm-expt/aicr-bundle at 0.21.0. That package is not published, so a destination needs a reachable copy before Argo CD can resolve them.
AICR generated this recipe for accelerator=any, intent=training, os=any, platform=any, service=ocp. A destination has to match those criteria, and nothing here has checked one.

stages.question: What do I have?
stages.answer: Inspect or compare AICR snapshots without selecting a recipe. The diff reports observed differences; select the intended provider-curated source variant before deciding whether a difference is a fault.
stages.nextAction: Inspect or compare the source and exact files before choosing a destination.
requiredInputs: An AICR snapshot, recipe, generated bundle, or exact generated output

stages.question: What will it produce?
stages.answer: The recipe declares 12 dependency edges that name components it does not deploy, and nothing here shows whether their order matters to the components it does deploy.
stages.nextAction: Review the exact object set and its digest, and settle the open question before relying on the recorded order.
requiredInputs: The selected provider-curated AICR leaf and its overlay choices; a recipe is needed for recipe-dependent generation or validation

stages.question: Can this destination accept it?
stages.answer: The destination has not been checked for this exact configuration. A recorded source or render result is not a destination pass.
